description: Check source strings for translation readiness. Give `strings` (one per line, optionally 'key = text' and a trailing '[max 20]' limit), optionally `languages`, `maxChars` (a limit for every string) and `expansion` (your own factors, e.g. 'de=1.3, fr=1.25'; if omitted a default planning table of our own rough factors is used and named in the output). Projects length per language (short strings grow more), flags overflow against limits, and flags: fragments glued together, unnamed multiple placeholders, '(s)' plurals and counted nouns without a plural rule, 'a/an' before a placeholder, hard-coded dates, times, ordinals, currency and number separators, gendered pairs, left/right words, idioms, Latin abbreviations, markup, emoji and all-capital text. Pattern checks on English; character counts are not pixel widths.

expansion.description: Expansion factors by language, e.g. 'de=1.3, fr=1.25' or {de: 1.3}

languages.description: Language codes to project, default all in the table

maxChars.description: Character limit applied to every string

name: localisation_readiness
title: Localisation readiness
